title: The Whale
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Andy is seen sailing and humorously communicating via computer, while Dwight is tasked with a new sales opportunity involving the Scranton White Pages but struggles with selling to women, receiving coaching from Pam and Phyllis. Jim is excited about a new company he is helping start but faces interruptions during a conference call. The office men participate in Movember to raise awareness for prostate cancer. Angela suspects a senator is having an affair, a topic she discusses with Oscar. Jan unexpectedly arrives, causing tension and revealing she has business unrelated to Pam and Dwight, while Dwight tries to impress her and shows unexpected kindness to Molly.

main_threads.thread: Dwight's challenge with selling to female clients and his training with Pam and Phyllis to improve his approach.

evidence.snippet: Dwight (answEring phone): Dwight Schrute. Well, hi there David Wallace.
Phyllis: Dwight, you can't go. You have a problem with women. You can't sell to them.
Dwight: That is a damnable lie. I love women.
Dwight: Okay, this isn't working for me, 'cause no one would ever believe that she would be a boss.
Dwight: I never sit down during sales meetings. I want to appear aggressive and imposing.
Pam: A little smile and a nod shows that I hear you. Got it?

main_threads.thread: Jim's involvement with a new company and his conference call experiences.

evidence.snippet: Jim: I have this conference call today with this company in Philly that I'm helping start.

Jim: I have this conference call today with this company in Philly that I'm helping start. Ah, first board meeting. Also, the first time I've ever been excited about work.
